package epm

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"testing"

	"github.com/oiweiwei/go-msrpc/midl/uuid"
	"github.com/oiweiwei/go-msrpc/msrpc/dcetypes"
	"github.com/oiweiwei/go-msrpc/ndr"
)

func TestQualificationGenerateMapFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	drs := &uuid.UUID{TimeLow: 0xe3514235, TimeMid: 0x4b06, TimeHiAndVersion: 0x11d1, ClockSeqHiAndReserved: 0xab, ClockSeqLow: 4, Node: [6]byte{0, 0xc0, 0x4f, 0xc2, 0xdc, 0xd2}}
	transfer := &uuid.UUID{TimeLow: 0x8a885d04, TimeMid: 0x1ceb, TimeHiAndVersion: 0x11c9, ClockSeqHiAndReserved: 0x9f, ClockSeqLow: 0xe8, Node: [6]byte{8, 0, 0x2b, 0x10, 0x48, 0x60}}
	tower := func(port []byte) *dcetypes.Tower {
		return dcetypes.FloorsToTower([]*dcetypes.Floor{
			{Protocol: 0x0d, UUID: drs, VersionMajor: 4, Data: []byte{0, 0}},
			{Protocol: 0x0d, UUID: transfer, VersionMajor: 2, Data: []byte{0, 0}},
			{Protocol: 0x0b, Data: []byte{0, 0}},
			{Protocol: 7, Data: port},
			{Protocol: 9, Data: []byte{192, 0, 2, 77}},
		})
	}
	requestTower := tower([]byte{0, 0})
	copy(requestTower.TowerOctetString[len(requestTower.TowerOctetString)-4:], []byte{0, 0, 0, 0})
	for name, message := range map[string]ndr.Marshaler{
		"map-request": &MapRequest{MapTower: requestTower, MaxTowers: 1},
		"map-response": &MapResponse{MaxTowers: 1, Towers: []*dcetypes.Tower{tower([]byte{0xc0, 0x01})}},
		"map-refusal": &MapResponse{MaxTowers: 1, Status: 1753},
		"map-free": &LookupHandleFreeResponse{},
	} {
		wire, err := ndr.Marshal(message)
		if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
		t.Logf("fixture %s %s", name, hex.EncodeToString(wire))
	}
}
